title: Wieszcz-XIX：31亿词1918年前波兰语语料库及时间限定语言模型
summary: 构建了包含67.5亿token（约31亿词）的1800-1918年波兰语历史语料库，规模超现有标注语料三个数量级，并从头训练47M至349M参数的仅解码器模型，验证其时间限定性：模型对1918年后词汇的困惑度显著更高，且能更好保留历史拼写。
summary_en: Presents Wieszcz-XIX, a 6.75B-token (about 3.1B-word) corpus of Polish published 1800-1918, over three orders of magnitude larger than prior annotated corpora, with audited post-1918 leakage. Trains decoder-only models from 47M to 349M parameters from scratch, showing temporal boundedness: post-1918 vocabulary costs ~3.1 bits/byte more, and models preserve period spelling better than modern comparators.
